records.title: Lithium ion battery with inorganic isolation layers, and method and device for manufacturing lithium ion battery

titles.text: Lithium ion battery with inorganic isolation layers, and method and device for manufacturing lithium ion battery

records.abstractExcerpt: The invention discloses a lithium ion battery with inorganic isolation layers, and a method and a device for manufacturing the lithium ion battery. High-temperature-resistant insulating inorganic compound materials are coated on pole pieces of a battery to form the lithium ion battery. The lithium ion battery, the method and the device have the advantages that membranes are replaced by the inorganic coating layers, so that positive and negative electrodes can be electronically insulated, and ions of the positive and negative electrodes can be conducted after electrolyte is absorbed; electronic insulation faults of the inorganic coating layers can be prevented at the high temperatures of 200 Celsius degrees, accordingly, internal short circuit of the lithium ion battery at the high temperatures of 200 Celsius degrees can be assuredly prevented, and the safety performance of the lithium ion battery can be greatly improved.

records.abstractExcerpt: The invention discloses an aqueous binder and a secondary battery. The adhesive has self-repairing capability and is a polymer containing at least two monomer units, wherein one monomer contains both a sulfonic acid group and an amide group, and the other monomer contains an alcohol ester group or/and a carboxylic acid ester group. The number average molecular weight of the polymer is preferably 20 ten thousand or more. The invention also relates to a secondary battery, which comprises a positive pole piece, a negative pole piece, a separation film and electrolyte, wherein at least one of the positive pole piece, the negative pole piece and the separation film (preferably the negative pole piece) contains the binder. Compared with the binder in the prior art, the binder provided by the invention has the advantages of high electrochemical stability, strong binding capacity and good mechanical property, and can be used for remarkably prolonging the cycle life of a secondary battery and reducing the cycle expansion. Therefore, the binder material has good application prospect in secondary batteries. 本发明公开了一种水性粘结剂及二次电池。该粘结剂具有自修复能力，是包含至少两种单体单元的聚合物，其中一种单体同时包含有磺酸基和酰胺基，另一种单体包含有醇酯基或/和羧酸酯基。聚合物数均分子量优选为大于等于20万。本发明还涉及一种二次电池，包含正极极片、负极极片、隔离膜和电解质，所述正极极片、负极极片、隔离膜中至少之一(优选负极极片)中含有本发明的粘结剂。本发明所述的粘结剂相比于现有技术中的粘结剂，电化学稳定性高，粘结能力强，机械性能好，可以显著提高二次电池的循环寿命及降低循环膨胀。因此，该粘结剂材料在二次电池中有很好的应用前景。

titles.text: Preparation and application of PEO-based film coated silicon-carbon electrode
一种PEO基薄膜包覆的硅碳电极的制备与应用

records.abstractExcerpt: 本发明提供了一种PEO基薄膜包覆硅碳电极的制备方法与应用。该方法包括以下步骤：1)制备硅碳负极电极片作为基底；2)配制PEO基混合溶液，将配制好的溶液刮涂在硅碳电极基底上；3)晾干硅碳电极片，得到PEO基薄膜包覆的硅碳电极，将其应用在锂离子电池中。本发明利用PEO的弹性以及锂盐可传导锂离子的性质，配制PEO与锂盐的混合溶液。将混合溶液刮涂在硅碳电极片，使其形成一层保护薄膜。当PEO基混合溶液的PEO质量浓度为3％时，其电池表现出最优的循环稳定性。在充放电过程中，薄膜中的锂盐可传导锂离子，弹性PEO膜可缓冲在充放电过程中体积膨胀所带来的应力，减小电极片的破裂粉碎。 The invention provides a preparation method and application of a PEO-based film coated silicon-carbon electrode. The method comprises the following steps: 1) preparing a silicon-carbon negative electrode plate as a substrate; 2) preparing a PEO-based mixed solution, and blade-coating the prepared solution on a silicon-carbon electrode substrate; 3) and (4) airing the silicon-carbon electrode plate to obtain the PEO-based film coated silicon-carbon electrode, and applying the silicon-carbon electrode in the lithium ion battery. The invention utilizes the elasticity of PEO and the property that lithium salt can conduct lithium ions to prepare the mixed solution of PEO and lithium salt. And (3) blade-coating the mixed solution on a silicon-carbon electrode plate to form a layer of protective film. When the PEO mass concentration of the PEO-based mixed solution was 3%, the battery exhibited the optimum cycle stability. During the charging and discharging processes, lithium salt in the film can conduct lithium ions, and the elastic PEO film can buffer stress caused by volume expansion during the charging and discharging processes, so that breakage and crushing of the electrode plate are reduced.
records.claimsExcerpt: 1. A PEO-based film coated silicon carbon electrode is characterized by comprising the following specific preparation processes: (1) weighing silicon-carbon negative electrode materials, a water-based binder and a conductive agent (super P), uniformly mixing and grinding according to a certain proportion, adding a proper amount of ultrapure water, and placing on a magnetic stirrer to fully stir for 8 hours. Coating, and then placing in a vacuum drying oven for drying at 80 ℃ for later use; (2) dissolving PEO in acetonitrile, fully mixing and dissolving, adding lithium salt, and uniformly mixing to prepare mixed solution of PEO with different mass fractions for later use; (3) and fixing the dried silicon-carbon electrode plate on a glass plate, selecting a proper thickness of a scraper, scraping the mixed solution on the electrode plate, and airing in a glove box to volatilize the acetonitrile solvent to obtain the PEO-based film coated silicon-carbon electrode. 2. The PEO-based film coated silicon carbon electrode of claim 1, wherein: the silicon-carbon negative electrode material includes, but is not limited to, silicon carbon 650 and silicon carbon 480. 3. The PEO-based film coated silicon carbon electrode of claim 1, wherein: the proportion of the silicon-carbon negative electrode material, the aqueous binder and the conductive agent (super P) includes but is not limited to 8:1:1, 6:2: 2. 4. The PEO-based film coated silicon carbon electrode of claim 1, wherein: the PEO mixed solution contains 1-5% of PEO by mass. 5. The PEO-based film coated silicon carbon electrode of claim 1, wherein: the molar ratio of the PEO to the lithium salt in the PEO-based mixed solution is 1: 5-1: 25, and preferably 1: 10-1: 20. 6. The PEO-based thin film coated silicon carbon electrode of claim 1 or 5, wherein: the lithium salt comprises one or more of lithium hexafluorophosphate, lithium perchlorate, lithium bis (trifluoromethane) sulfonyl imide and lithium bis (fluorosulfonyl) imide. 7. The PEO-based thin film coated silicon carbon electrode of claim 1 or 5, wherein: the thickness of the scraper is 250 mm-750 mm, specifically 500 mm.

titles.text: Aqueous binder for lithium ion battery diaphragm
锂离子电池隔膜用水性粘结剂

records.abstractExcerpt: 本申请涉及锂离子电池隔膜材料领域，更具体地说，它涉及一种锂离子电池隔膜用水性粘结剂。包括颗粒状聚合物A和颗粒状聚合物B，颗粒状聚合物A的玻璃化转变温度小于颗粒状聚合物B的玻璃化转变温度，颗粒状聚合物A的颗粒度D50为0.05‑1.0μm，颗粒状聚合物B的颗粒度D10为1.0‑5.0μm，D50为2.0‑10μm，D90为3.0‑20μm。本申请的水性粘结剂具有粘接强度高的优点，并且采用本水性粘结剂制得的复合隔膜透气度好，易于收卷储存。 The application relates to the field of lithium ion battery diaphragm materials, in particular to an aqueous binder for a lithium ion battery diaphragm. records.abstractExcerpt: 为克服现有技术中锂电池的电芯强度低、电池易出现扭曲变形的技术问题，本申请提供一种水性粘结剂及改性隔膜和电池；水性粘结剂是具有核壳结构的粘结剂颗粒，所述核壳结构的粘结剂颗粒中核是聚合物A，壳是聚合物B；所述核的玻璃化转变温度为80℃～150℃；所述壳的玻璃化转变温度为30℃～70℃。本申请提供的核壳结构的粘结剂颗粒，涂覆于隔膜基材表面，制备得到的电芯经过热压后，隔膜与正负极片粘结成一体，使得电池具有更高的强度，电池的抗扭曲变形性好，同时提升隔膜的透气性，降低电池生产成本，适用于生产薄型电池，并保持好的电池性能。 In order to overcome the technical problems that the strength of a battery core of a lithium battery is low and the battery is easy to distort and deform in the prior art, the application provides the aqueous binder, the modified diaphragm and the battery; the water-based binder is binder particles with a core-shell structure, wherein the core of the binder particles with the core-shell structure is a polymer A, and the shell of the binder particles with the core-shell structure is a polymer B; the glass transition temperature of the core is 80-150 ℃; the glass transition temperature of the shell is 30-70 ℃. The application provides a binder granule of nucleocapsid structure coats in diaphragm substrate surface, and the electric core that the preparation obtained is through hot pressing after, the diaphragm bonds with positive and negative pole piece and becomes an organic whole for the battery has higher intensity, and the distortion resistance nature of battery is good, promotes the gas permeability of diaphragm simultaneously, reduces battery manufacturing cost, is applicable to the production slim battery, and keeps good battery performance.
records.claimsExcerpt: 1. The aqueous binder as claimed in claim 1, wherein the binder particles have a particle size in the range of 1 to 10 μm; the particle size range of the core is 0.5 to 4 μm. 3. The aqueous binder as claimed in claim 2, wherein the mass ratio of the core to the shell is 1: (0.2-10). 4. The aqueous binder according to claim 1, wherein the reactants for preparing the polymer a comprise a polymerization monomer a1, a cross-linking agent a2, a dispersant a3 and an initiator a4; based on 100 percent of the mass of the polymerization reaction monomer a1, the mass proportion of the cross-linking agent a2 is 4 to 30 percent, the mass proportion of the dispersing agent a3 is 0.1 to 25 percent, and the mass proportion of the initiator a4 is 0.3 to 5 percent. 5. The aqueous binder as claimed in claim 1, wherein the reactants for preparing the polymer B comprise a polymerization monomer B1, a cross-linking agent B2, a dispersant B3 and an initiator B4, and are prepared by dispersion polymerization; based on 100 percent of the mass of the polymerization reaction monomer b1, the mass of the cross-linking agent b2 is 1 to 20 percent, the mass of the dispersing agent b3 is 0 to 10 percent, and the mass of the initiator b4 is 0.5 to 5 percent. 7. The aqueous binder as claimed in claim 6, wherein the polymerization monomer b1 comprises one or more of acrylonitrile, methacrylonitrile, acrylates, styrene; the crosslinking agent b2 comprises one or more of diacetone acrylamide, acetoacetoxyethyl methacrylate, N-hydroxymethyl acrylamide, N-hydroxyethyl acrylamide, divinylbenzene, diallyl phthalate and trimethylolpropane triacrylate; the dispersant b3 comprises one or more of sodium carboxymethylcellulose, a nonionic surfactant, polyvinylpyrrolidone and polyethylene glycol; the initiator b4 comprises one or more of persulfate, azobisisobutyronitrile, dimethyl azobisisobutyrate, benzoyl peroxide and di-n-octanoyl peroxide. 8. The method for preparing an aqueous binder according to any one of claims 1 to 7, wherein: the method comprises the following steps: (1) Preparation of the core solution: adding a solvent and an initiator a4 into a reaction kettle, uniformly stirring, then adding a polymerization reaction monomer a1 and a cross-linking agent a2, stirring, introducing a protective atmosphere, adding a dispersing agent a3, heating to react at the reaction temperature of 50-90 ℃ for 4-24 h, and preparing a nuclear solution after the reaction is finished; the mass ratio of the polymerization reaction monomer a1 to the solvent is 10-45%; (2) Preparing a core-shell structure binder: mixing the core solution with a polymer B, or mixing the core solution with a reactant for preparing the polymer B, heating to react, wherein the reaction temperature is 50-90 ℃, the reaction time is 4-24 h, and preparing the binder with the core-shell structure after the reaction is finished; the solvent comprises one or more of water and alcohol compounds. 9. A lithium battery comprising a positive electrode sheet, a negative electrode sheet, and a separator interposed between adjacent positive and negative electrode sheets, wherein the separator is the modified separator according to claim 9.

records.abstractExcerpt: La présente invention concerne une suspension aqueuse épaisse de cathode pour batterie au lithium-ion qui contient un matériau actif de cathode comprenant une poudre d'oxyde de métal de transition-lithium, la poudre d'oxyde de métal de transition-lithium étant constituée d'agglomérats de particules primaires, les particules primaires comprenant une couche d'enrobage contenant un polymère. Le polymère est de préférence un polymère fluoré comprenant au moins 50 % en poids de fluor. La couche d'enrobage comprend de préférence une première couche interne d'enrobage et une seconde couche externe d'enrobage, la seconde couche externe comprenant le polymère fluoré et la première couche interne étant constituée d'un produit réactionnel issu de la réaction entre le polymère fluoré et la surface des particules primaires. Le produit réactionnel comprend de préférence du LiF. records.claimsExcerpt: A method comprising: applying a wet bond coat slurry (14) to a damaged area of a coating system on a metal substrate (34), wherein the bond coat slurry comprises a liquid binder, at least one of glass particles or glass-ceramic particles, and ceramic oxide particles; depositing a plurality of fibers (16) onto the wet bond coat slurry at least one of during or after the wet bond coat slurry is applied to the damaged area, wherein the plurality of fibers includes at least one of metallic fibers or ceramic fibers; applying a ceramic composite slurry (20) on the bond coat to form a ceramic composite layer (48), wherein, during the application of the ceramic composite slurry on the bond coat, the bond coat is wet or at least partially dried (18), wherein the wet or at least partially dried bond coat includes a plurality of partially exposed fibers, wherein, following the application of the ceramic composite slurry, a first portion of individual fibers of the plurality of fibers are embedded in the wet or at least partially dried bond coat and a second portion of the individual fibers of the plurality of fibers extend into the layer of the ceramic composite slurry; and heating the wet or at least partially dried bond coat and the ceramic composite layer (24) to form a repaired portion of the coating system on the metal substrate, wherein heating the bond coat melts at least a portion of the at least one of the glass particles or the glass-ceramic particles to form a fully amorphous glass phase or a mixture of amorphous and crystalline glass phases which bond with the metal substrate. The method of claim 1, wherein the liquid binder of the bond coat slurry comprises at least one of an ethyl polysilicate binder or other silicon alkoxide binder. The method of claim 2, wherein the ceramic composite slurry applied to the at least partially dried bond coat comprises the at least one of the ethyl polysilicate binder or other silicon alkoxide binder. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the at least one of glass particles or glass-ceramic particles comprise glass-ceramic powder. The method of claim 4, wherein the glass-ceramic powder comprises at least one of Ba-Ca-Si-B-Al, Si-Al-R 2 O-B, Ba-Si-Al-Mg-B, and Ba-Sr-Ca-Si-Al-Mg-B. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the bond coat slurry comprises a catalyst for a sol-gel reaction of the bond coat. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the ceramic oxide particles comprise at least one of MgO, Al 2 O 3 , and MgAl 2 O 4 particles. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the metal substrate comprises the metal substrate of an in-service component. The method of claim 8, wherein the in-service component comprises an exhaust component of a gas turbine engine mounted to an aircraft. The method of any preceding claim, wherein heating the wet or at least partially dried bond coat and the ceramic composite layer to form a repaired portion of the thermal barrier coating system on the metal substrate comprises heating the wet or at least partially dried bond coat and the ceramic composite layer via exhaust gas of the gas turbine engine. The method of any preceding claim, wherein at least a portion of the ceramic oxide particles remain unreacted following the heating of the wet or at least partially dried bond coat and the ceramic composite layer. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the metal substrate comprises a nickel superalloy, a cobalt superalloy, or a titanium alloy. The method of claim 8 or 9, or any one of claims 10 to 12 when dependent on claim 8, further comprising leaving the in-service component as part of an assembly throughout the method of claim 1. An assembly comprising: a metal substrate (34); a coating system (32) on the metal substrate; and a repaired portion of the coating system on the metal substrate, the repaired portion comprising: a bond coat layer (44) on the metal substrate, wherein the bond coat layer includes a glass or glass-ceramic including an amorphous glass phase and one or more crystalline ceramic phases bonded to the metal substrate, and one or more ceramic oxide phases, a ceramic composite layer (48), and a plurality of fibers (46), wherein the plurality of fibers includes at least one of metallic fibers or ceramic fibers, wherein a first portion of individual fibers of the plurality of fibers are embedded in the dried bond coat and a second portion of the individual fibers of the plurality of fibers extend into the ceramic composite layer. The assembly of claim 14, wherein the metal substrate comprises a metal substrate of an in-service component, and the in-service component comprises an exhaust component of a gas turbine engine mounted to an aircraft.

records.title: Process for forming multilayer coating

titles.text: Process for forming multilayer coating

records.abstractExcerpt: A process for forming a multilayer coating. The process enables coating of multiple layers by a continuous process in which mixing and diffusion between the layers is prevented. The process is particularly useful for producing, e.g., electrophotographic photoreceptors or photosensitive printing plate precursors comprising two or more coating layers.
records.claimsExcerpt: What is claimed is:1. A process for forming a multilayer coating film comprising the steps of:(a) atomizing a first coating composition in an atomizing room; (b) forced draft conveying the atomized first coating composition from said atomizing room through an elongate transport passage to a supply nozzle such that large diameter particles of the first coating composition impact against and adhere to wall surfaces of the passage; (c) establishing a high voltage electrical potential across an outlet of the nozzle to electrostatically charge the atomized first coating composition exiting the nozzle; (d) impacting the electrostatically charged atomized first coating composition against a surface of a moving web such that the coating composition adheres to the web and forms a first coating film layer thereon; (e) partially drying the first coating film layer so that a viscosity of the first coating film layer is 100 cp or more; (f) repeating steps (a) through (d) for a second coating composition to form a second coating film layer on an upper surface of said first coating film layer; and (g) running said first and second coating film layers, formed on said moving web, through a final drying zone to fully dry said multilayer coating film. 2. A process for forming a multilayer coating film, as recited in claim 1, wherein said first and second coating film layers are force draft conveyed through separate, consecutive transport passages. 3. A process for forming a multilayer coating film, as recited in claim 2, wherein said moving web passes through a partial drying zone, between said separate, consecutive transport passages, for partially drying said first layer. 4. A process for forming a multilayer coating film, as recited in claim 1, wherein said web carried a sheet-like body to be coated and wherein said multilayer coating film is formed on an upper surface of said sheet-like body carried by said web. 5. A process for forming a multilayer coating film, as recited in claim 1, wherein the mean diameter of the atomized coating composition particles is less than or equal to about 50 μm. 6. A process for forming a multilayer coating film, as recited in claim 1, wherein the viscosity of the atomized coating composition ranges from between about 5 cP and about 100 cP. 7. A process for forming a multilayer coating film, as recited in claim 4, wherein said process is used to produce a photosensitive printing plate precursor comprising a plurality of layers of a photosensitive coating component formed on said sheet-like body. 8. A process for forming a multilayer elating film comprising the steps of:(a) atomizing a first coating composition in an atomizing room; (b) forced draft conveying the atomized first coating composition from said atomizing room through an elongate transport passage to a supply nozzle such that large diameter particles of the first coating composition impact against and adhere to wall surfaces of the passage; (c) establishing a high voltage electrical potential across an outlet of the nozzle to electrostatically charge the atomized first coating composition existing the nozzle; (d) impacting the electrostatically charged atomized first coating composition against a surface of a moving web such that the coating composition adheres to the web and forms a first coating film layer thereon; (e) partially drying the first coating film layer so that a viscosity of the first coating film layer is 100 cp or more; (f) repeating steps (a) and (e) for a second coating composition to form a second coating film layer on an upper surface of said first coating film layer; (g) repeating steps (a) through (d) for a third coating composition to form a third coating film layer on an upper surface of said second coating film layer; and (h) running said first, second and third coating film layers, formed on said moving web, through a final drying zone to fully dry said multilayer coating film. 9.
